findings.summary: The verified clone ended in a whiteout; live execution remains forbidden.
findings.observed_fact: Lildozer entered at 7/58 against full Dustox and fainted before Bulldoze executed.

findings.summary: The Eelektrik rule forbade a second Razor Leaf after one use, so Bushtank selected lower-damage Bite while no safe converter could enter.
findings.observed_fact: At the turn-11 certificate Razor Leaf was legal with verified 13-16 damage; the policy vetoed it and selected Bite at 10-12 damage.

findings.summary: The Eelektrik line spent four healthy resources as emergency pivots and left Bugatti at 17 HP before Dustox.
findings.observed_fact: Bugatti was switched into Eelektrik at 41 HP and took a verified 24 damage before it could attack.

findings.summary: Bugatti entered Dustox at 17 HP and Rollout allowed Infestation plus Venoshock to remove the designated finisher.
findings.observed_fact: Fresh Dustox used Infestation and Venoshock; Bugatti fainted before the locked Rollout line could mature.

findings.summary: No verified healthy Dustox answer remained after the Eelektrik attrition; the forced Lildozer replacement was not a viable winning line.
findings.observed_fact: Only Lildozer at 7/58 was legal after Bugatti fainted; this was a consequence of reserve loss, not an independent tactical choice.

findings.summary: Fourteen switches in 28 actions extended the line without preserving enough endgame HP.
findings.observed_fact: The certified transaction stream contains 14 switches, 13 move PP decrements, and five allied faints.

findings.summary: The loss consumed 28 certified actions; shorter-line work is secondary to survival and finisher preservation.
findings.observed_fact: No execution or observation mismatch was found; this is a tempo metric only.

correct_choices: Spark removed Bibarel while preserving Ohmnomnom through the forced Super Fang reply.
Lildozer used two Bulldozes to remove Ponyta without a burn.
Fresh Croakatoa used Fake Out against Eelektrik and verified the expected flinch/no-reply turn.
